GLDDF.Dialog.FatedRollHint: Roll the Destiny Fate Die with this PF2e check.
GLDDF.Settings.Preset.Name: Terminology Preset
GLDDF.Settings.Preset.Hint: Selects which set of labels, colors, and dice art to use for fate die results. Default uses Opportunity/Complication. Aegis Fallen uses Defiance/Tyranny. Tides of Destiny uses Tide/Storm.
GLDDF.Settings.EmissiveIntensity.Name: Dice Emission Intensity
GLDDF.Settings.EmissiveIntensity.Hint: Controls the glow strength of the Destiny Dice emission maps in Dice So Nice. 0 disables the glow; 1.0 uses the map's baked-in color as-is; higher values brighten the glow further. Requires a reload.
GLDDF.Settings.MotionTier.Name: Animation Style
GLDDF.Settings.MotionTier.Hint: Controls the Etched Glass result-card animations. Reduced uses simple fades; Default plays the full reveal sweep; Cinematic lengthens the ceremony with a trailing flare. Forced to Reduced when your system requests reduced motion.
GLDDF.Settings.FaceConfig.Name: Dice Faces
GLDDF.Settings.FaceConfig.Label: Configure
GLDDF.Settings.FaceConfig.Hint: Configure each physical die face: result kind, numeric value, and PNG texture.
GLDDF.Settings.FaceConfig.Title: Destiny Dice Faces
GLDDF.Settings.FaceConfig.ReloadHint: Dice So Nice texture changes require a Foundry reload. Result and value changes apply to future fate rolls.
GLFC.Config.Name: Fate Coin
GLFC.Config.Label: Configure
GLFC.Config.Hint: Configure the Fate Coin: Boon/Bane labels, custom texture/bump/emission maps per side, edge texture, and optional sound effects.
GLFC.Config.Title: Fate Coin Configuration
GLFC.Config.ReloadHint: Texture, bump, and emission maps are read at flip time. Bump maps should be normal maps (Babylon convention). Leave any field blank to use the procedural default.
GLFC.Control.Title: Fate Coin
GLFC.Dialog.Title: Flip the Fate Coin
GLFC.Dialog.Hint: Stage a dramatic, table-wide coin flip.
GLFC.Dialog.ThresholdHint: The result is a Boon if at least this many coins land on the good side.
GLFC.Overlay.YourFlip: The coin is yours. Flip it.
GLFC.Card.Speaker: Fate Coin
GLFC.Notify.GMOnly: Only a GM can summon the Fate Coin.
GLFC.Notify.InProgress: A Fate Coin flip is already in progress.
GLFC.Notify.FlipperOffline: The chosen flipper is not online.
